summary: Customer FabBar live UI flow verified end-to-end after active orders were cleared. Login (phone+2 checkboxes+OTP), pin-setup skip, sheet handle collapse, FabBar reveal, custom button modal open/close, and primary button (expand sheet → FabBar hides) all work correctly. Driver flow also verified: driver +79007654321 logs in (no consent checkboxes on driver auth), lands on /driver, FabBar visible with primary 'На линии' button. Driver was already activated; no admin activation step required.

issues: Map background (teal grid / map_bg_color) bleeds into auth pages — known cosmetic from iteration 11; not part of this test scope.

critical_code_review_comments: FabBar.jsx renders icon_svg and content_html via dangerouslySetInnerHTML — fine for admin-only authoring; recommend DOMPurify if non-admin roles ever get write access.
Driver auth screen does NOT have consent checkboxes while customer auth does — inconsistent UX (legal compliance review may want consents on both flows).

Driver /driver page shows console: 'Location watch error: GeolocationPositionError' on every load — geolocation is denied in the browser sandbox; should fail silently or show inline status instead of console.error.

success_rate.frontend: Customer FabBar full flow 100% (login, sheet collapse, FabBar render, custom-button modal open/close, primary expand-sheet). Driver FabBar 100% (login + primary 'На линии' visible).

rca of the issue: Previously (iteration 11) customer FabBar could not be tested because customer had an active order (orderState !== 'idle'). Main agent cancelled all active orders in DB → orderState now returns 'idle' → FabBar render guard (orderState==='idle' && sheetCollapsed && !showMenu && !showProfile && !showHistory && !showProblem) now passes once sheet is collapsed. No code change required.
